role.summary: Main agent plans and reviews; delegates implementation and research.

implementation.notes: Coding implementation. Use options {variant: high}. The reasoningEffort field is a preset placeholder and does not apply to OpenCode.

fix-up rounds.notes: Address review findings. Use options {variant: high}, and {variant: max} for repair 2. The reasoningEffort field does not apply to OpenCode.

research.notes: Research/web lookup only; never planning, decisions, or code.

acceptance_checklist: Every brief lists acceptance criteria and minimum test expectations.
Parent reads diffs and rejects placeholder or tautological tests before merge.
policies.provider_limit_notes: If a delegate provider hits a usage limit, do not switch providers unasked: schedule a one-time retry after reset and tell the user the alternatives.
